sections.Profile:
The "Galaxy" pinball machine, produced by Stern Electronics in 1980, is renowned for its space-themed gameplay and distinctive artwork. Designed by Harry Williams with art by Bob Timm, this solid-state machine features a combination of three pop bumpers, a four-bank drop target, a rollunder spinner, a kick-out hole, and a kickback lane, creating a dynamic and engaging playfield. It is also notable for being one of the first machines to incorporate computer-controlled general illumination, enhancing the visual experience.
